title: Synchronize system clock with SNTP server
summary: Force your Mac's system clock to update immediately by synchronizing it with a specified SNTP server. This requires administrator privileges.

steps.explain: Use sudo to run sntp with the -S flag to force the system clock to synchronize with the specified server.

placeholders.name: SERVER
placeholders.description: The hostname of the SNTP server to synchronize with

steps.expect: The system clock is updated to match the server's time.

rollback.explain: There is no direct undo command for time synchronization. You can re-enable automatic time synchronization in System Settings > General > Date & Time.

warnings: This changes the system clock immediately. If the server time is incorrect, it may affect scheduled tasks or file timestamps.
